title: 第7章 徐福东渡，寻长生不老药
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
李斯点了点头，将这些话默默记在心里。

    “下官明白了。”

    他再次躬身一拜，“下官会全力配合上卿，只望……上卿能早日功成。”

    说完，他便退了出去。

    看着李斯离去的背影，顾长青知道，这位大秦丞相，已经被自己暂时说服了。

    至少，在自己“功成”之前，他不会再来捣乱。

    现在，万事俱备。

    他已经撒下了一张遍布整个天下的大网。

    接下来，就是漫长的，等待。

    等待着，那渺茫的希望，从某个不知名的角落，被发掘出来。

    时间，在漫长的等待中，悄然流逝。

    又是五年过去。

    大秦帝国在始皇帝的统治下，日益强盛。

    书同文，车同轨，统一度量衡。

    一项项影响深远的国策，从咸阳发出，深刻地改变着这片土地。

    驰道，从咸阳向四方延伸，如同帝国的血脉，将遥远的边疆与心脏紧密连接。

    北击匈奴，收复河套，筑长城以御外敌。

    南征百越，开灵渠沟通水系。

    大秦的疆域，在不断地扩张。

    始皇帝的威望，也达到了前所未有的顶峰。

    然而，在这辉煌的表象之下，潜藏的暗流，也在悄然涌动。

    为了支持这一个个浩大的工程，以及那座如同无底洞的“求仙宫”，帝国的赋税，日益沉重。

    百姓的怨言，在私下里悄悄流传。

    而这一切，似乎都与上卿府里的那个人，无关。……

    上卿府，密室。

    顾长青缓缓睁开眼睛，结束了一次长达数月的闭关。

    他的修为，依旧停留在筑基后期的顶峰，距离圆满，始终差了那么。

    没有足够的灵气和天材地宝，单靠苦修，进境微乎其微。

    这五年来，“求仙宫”送来的东西，堆积如山。

    各种奇形怪状的石头，不知名的草木，甚至还有人献上了所谓的“龙骨”、“凤羽”。

    但经过顾长青的甄别，九成九，都是凡物。

    只有极少数的几样东西，蕴含着微弱的灵气，但也只是杯水车薪，对他冲击金丹，起不到任何实质性的作用。

    他所描绘的那些真正的灵草图谱，发往天下，至今没有一株被找到。

    那些东西，真的只存在于神话传说之中。

    “难道，这个世界的灵气，真的已经枯竭到连一株灵草都无法诞生了吗？”
content_en:
Li Si nodded and kept these words in his heart.

    "I understand."

    He bowed again and said, "I will fully cooperate with you. I just hope that... you can succeed as soon as possible."

    After saying that, he retreated.

    Looking at Li Si's leaving figure, Gu Changqing knew that the Prime Minister of Great Qin had been temporarily convinced by him.

    At least, he won't cause trouble again until he "succeeds".

    Now, everything is ready.

    He has cast a wide net across the entire world.

    Next, there is a long wait.

    Waiting for that slim hope to be discovered from some unknown corner.

    Time passed quietly in the long wait.

    Another five years have passed.

    Under the rule of the First Emperor, the Qin Empire grew stronger and stronger.

    Books share the same text, cars share the same track, and weights and measures are unified.

    A series of far-reaching national policies were issued from Xianyang, profoundly changing this land.

    Chidao extends from Xianyang to all directions, like the bloodline of the empire, closely connecting the distant frontiers with the heart.

    Attack the Xiongnu in the north, recover the Hetao, and build the Great Wall to defend against foreign enemies.

    They marched south to Baiyue and opened the Ling Canal to connect the water system.

    The territory of Da Qin is constantly expanding.

    The prestige of the First Emperor also reached an unprecedented peak.

    However, beneath this glorious appearance, hidden undercurrents are also quietly surging.

    In order to support these huge projects and the "Palace of Seeking Immortality" which is like a bottomless pit, the empire's taxes have become increasingly heavy.

    The complaints of the people were quietly circulated in private.

    And all of this seems to have nothing to do with the person in Shangqing's mansion. …

    Shangqing's Mansion, secret room.

    Gu Changqing slowly opened his eyes, ending a months-long retreat.

    His cultivation level is still at the peak of the late stage of foundation building, and he is still far away from perfection.

    Without enough spiritual energy and heavenly materials and earthly treasures, relying on hard work alone will make little progress.

    In the past five years, things sent from "Qiuxian Palace" have piled up like mountains.

    Various strange-shaped stones, unknown vegetation, and even so-called "dragon bones" and "phoenix feathers" were presented.

    But after Gu Changqing's screening, 99% of them are ordinary things.

    There are only a few items that contain weak spiritual energy, but they are only a drop in the bucket and cannot have any substantive effect on his impact on the golden elixir.

    The maps of the real spiritual herbs he described were sent all over the world, but not a single one has been found so far.

    Those things really only exist in myths and legends.

    "Is it true that the spiritual energy in this world has been so exhausted that not even a single spiritual grass can be born?"
title_en: Chapter 7 Xu Fu traveled eastward in search of the elixir of immortality
